mapper.sql:
FROM sys_user u WHERE 1=1 AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR u.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%')) AND u.status='ENABLED'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_organization grant_member JOIN sys_organization grant_org ON grant_org.id=grant_member.organization_id WHERE grant_member.user_id=u.id AND LEFT(grant_org.organization_path,CHAR_LENGTH(#{query.grantOrganizationPath}))=#{query.grantOrganizationPath})
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_organization m JOIN sys_organization o ON o.id=m.organization_id JOIN sys_organization school ON school.organization_type IN ('SCHOOL', 'TRAINING_INSTITUTION') AND o.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(school.organization_path,'%') WHERE m.user_id=u.id)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_organization m JOIN sys_organization o ON o.id=m.organization_id WHERE m.user_id=u.id AND o.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(#{query.schoolPath},'%'))
AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_organization m WHERE m.user_id=u.id AND m.organization_id IN #{id}) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_organization m WHERE m.user_id=u.id))
AND 1=0
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role r WHERE r.user_id=u.id AND r.role_id=#{query.roleId} AND r.organization_id=#{query.grantOrganizationId} AND r.organization_id IS NULL AND (r.organization_id IN #{id} OR (r.organization_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_organization m WHERE m.user_id=r.user_id AND m.organization_id IN #{id})))AND 1=0 )
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization_admin a WHERE a.user_id=u.id AND a.organization_id=#{query.targetOrganizationId})
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_organization m WHERE m.user_id=u.id AND m.organization_id=#{query.targetOrganizationId})
mapper.select:
SELECT u.id,u.username,u.display_name,u.mobile,u.password_hash,u.user_type,u.status,u.created_at,u.updated_at
ORDER BY
COALESCE((SELECT MIN(CASE m.organization_id WHEN #{id} THEN #{rank} ELSE 2147483647 END) FROM sys_user_organization m WHERE m.user_id=u.id),2147483647),
u.id LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT r.user_id,r.organization_id ORDER BY COALESCE(CASE r.organization_id WHEN #{id} THEN #{rank} ELSE NULL END, (SELECT MIN(CASE m.organization_id WHEN #{id} THEN #{rank} ELSE 2147483647 END) FROM sys_user_organization m WHERE m.user_id=r.user_id),2147483647), r.user_id,r.id LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.mobile, u.password_hash, u.user_type, u.status, u.created_at, u.updated_at
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, username, display_name, mobile, password_hash, user_type, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, username, display_name, mobile, password_hash, user_type, status, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user WHERE mobile = #{mobile} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, display_name FROM sys_user WHERE id IN #{id}

where.if:
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_organization membership WHERE membership.user_id = sys_user.id
AND membership.organization_id IN #{id} AND 1=0
AND membership.organization_id IN (SELECT child.id FROM sys_organization root JOIN sys_organization child ON child.id=root.id OR (root.organization_path IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(root.organization_path)>0 AND LEFT(child.organization_path,CHAR_LENGTH(root.organization_path))=root.organization_path) WHERE root.id=#{query.organizationId}))
AND (username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
